translations.EN: Good work. Keep watching the area.
translations.TL: Magandang trabaho. Patuloy na bantayan ang paligid.

translations.EN: Threat's handled. Stay on your toes.
translations.TL: Naasikaso ang banta. Maging handa.

translations.EN: Nice job. Don't relax just yet.
translations.TL: Mahusay. Huwag munang magpakampante.

translations.EN: Target down. Keep scanning the perimeter.
translations.TL: Bagsak ang target. Patuloy na suriin ang paligid.

translations.EN: Handled. Watch your surroundings.
translations.TL: Naasikaso na. Bantayan ang paligid mo.

translations.EN: Good strike. Stay vigilant.
translations.TL: Magandang tama. Manatiling alerto.

translations.EN: That one's finished. Check the corners.
translations.TL: Tapos na ang isang 'yon. Tignan ang mga sulok.

translations.EN: Well done. Keep weapons at the ready.
translations.TL: Magaling. Ihanda pa rin ang sandata.

translations.EN: Clear here. Eyes on the shadows.
translations.TL: Malinis dito. Tumingin sa mga anino.

translations.EN: Threat eliminated. Keep moving carefully.
translations.TL: Banta naalis na. Tuloy sa maingat na pagkilos.

translations.EN: I need a moment before I can swing again.
translations.TL: Kailangan ko muna ng saglit bago makahataw ulit.

translations.EN: Arms are heavy. Give me a second.
translations.TL: Mabigat ang mga braso ko. Bigyan mo ako ng saglit.

translations.EN: Falling back! Need to recover stamina.
translations.TL: Aatras muna! Kailangang makabawi ng lakas.

translations.EN: Out of breath! Step back a bit.
translations.TL: Hinihingal ako! Umatras muna nang kaunti.

translations.EN: Can't keep swinging like this. Backing up.
translations.TL: Hindi ko kayang tuloy-tuloy ang hataw. Aatras muna.

translations.EN: Give me space to breathe and reset.
translations.TL: Bigyan mo ako ng puwang para makahinga.

translations.EN: Too exhausted to strike. Pulling back.
translations.TL: Masyado akong pagod para humampas. Umuurong muna.

translations.EN: Need ten seconds to shake out my arms.
translations.TL: Kailangan ko ng sampung segundo para ipagpag ang braso ko.

translations.EN: Step back! I'm completely winded.
translations.TL: Atras! Sagad na ang hingal ko.

translations.EN: Back up! Let me catch my breath.
translations.TL: Umatras! Pahingahin mo muna ako.

translations.EN: That threat is down. Stay alert.
translations.TL: Bagsak na ang banta. Manatiling alerto.

translations.EN: Threat neutralized. Don't drop your guard.
translations.TL: Naalis na ang banta. Huwag ibaba ang depensa.

translations.EN: Target eliminated. Keep watching.
translations.TL: Target naalis na. Patuloy na magmatyag.

translations.EN: Danger's passed for now. Stay sharp.
translations.TL: Lumipas na ang panganib pansamantala. Maging handa.

translations.EN: Handled that hazard. Eyes open.
translations.TL: Nalutas ang panganib na 'yon. Buksan ang mata.

translations.EN: Threat's in the dirt. Scan the flanks.
translations.TL: Nasa lupa na ang banta. Suriin ang gilid.

translations.EN: Threat ceased. Maintain alertness.
translations.TL: Tumigil na ang banta. Panatilihin ang pag-iingat.

translations.EN: Downed the contact. Watch your sector.
translations.TL: Naitumba ang kalaban. Bantayan ang parte mo.

translations.EN: No more threat from that one. Stay ready.
translations.TL: Wala nang panganib mula sa kanya. Maging handa.

translations.EN: Handled. Stay focused on remaining risks.
translations.TL: Naayos na. Tutukan ang iba pang panganib.

translations.EN: Stay with me next time. We watch each other's backs.
translations.TL: Sumabay ka sa akin sa susunod. Nagbabantayan tayo ng likod.

translations.EN: Don't leave me behind like that. We survive together.
translations.TL: Huwag mo akong iiwan nang gano'n. Sabay tayong mabubuhay.

translations.EN: I almost got swarmed when you ran off. Stick close.
translations.TL: Halos makuyog ako no'ng umalis ka. Dumikit ka lang.

translations.EN: We're a team. Don't take off on your own.
translations.TL: Magkasama tayo. Huwag kang aalis nang mag-isa.

translations.EN: Where did you go?! You can't just vanish.
translations.TL: Saan ka pumunta?! Hindi ka pwedeng mawala na lang.

translations.EN: Next time, warn me before you leave.
translations.TL: Sa susunod, sabihan mo ako bago ka umalis.

translations.EN: Thought I was on my own out there. Stay together.
translations.TL: Akala ko naiwan na akong mag-isa. Magsama tayo.

translations.EN: Leaving your partner gets people killed. Keep near.
translations.TL: Ang pag-iwan sa kasama ay nakakamatay. Dumikit ka.

translations.EN: Glad you're back, but don't ditch me again.
translations.TL: Mabuti at bumalik ka, pero huwag mo na akong iiwan ulit.

translations.EN: Stick with me. We're stronger as a pair.
translations.TL: Sumabay ka sa akin. Mas malakas tayo kapag magkasama.

translations.EN: I can't find a safe room or campfire nearby.
translations.TL: Wala akong makitang ligtas na kwarto o campfire sa malapit.

translations.EN: Nowhere safe to rest around here. We need better cover.
translations.TL: Walang ligtas na pahingahan dito. Kailangan natin ng mas maayos na silungan.

translations.EN: Can't camp in the open like this. Too dangerous.
translations.TL: Hindi pwedeng magkampo sa lantad nang ganito. Masyadong delikado.

translations.EN: We need walls or a fire before we settle down.
translations.TL: Kailangan natin ng pader o apoy bago huminto.

translations.EN: This spot isn't secure enough for camp. Keep walking.
translations.TL: Hindi sapat ang kaligtasan ng pwestong 'to para sa kampo. Lakad pa.

translations.EN: No shelter here. Let's find four walls first.
translations.TL: Walang masisilungan dito. Maghanap muna tayo ng apat na pader.

translations.EN: Can't sleep here. Infected could walk right in.
translations.TL: Hindi pwedeng matulog dito. Madaling makakapasok ang mga infected.

translations.EN: We need a barricaded room or a campfire before resting.
translations.TL: Kailangan natin ng may barikadang kwarto o campfire bago magpahinga.

translations.EN: Not pitching camp here. Let's find a secure building.
translations.TL: Hindi ako magkakampo rito. Maghanap tayo ng ligtas na gusali.

translations.EN: Too exposed. Find us a real camp spot.
translations.TL: Masyadong lantad. Hanapan mo tayo ng tunay na matutuluyan.

translations.EN: I heard you. We will handle it together.
translations.TL: Narinig kita. Sabay natin 'yang haharapin.

translations.EN: Understood. I'm right here with you.
translations.TL: Naintindihan ko. Nandito lang ako kasama mo.

translations.EN: Got your message. Let's get it done.
translations.TL: Nakuha ko ang sabi mo. Tapusin na natin.

translations.EN: I'm with you. Lead the way.
translations.TL: Kasama mo ako. Ikaw ang manguna.

translations.EN: Heard. Whatever comes, we take it on.
translations.TL: Narinig ko. Kahit ano'ng dumating, lalabanan natin.

translations.EN: Copy that. Staying right by your side.
translations.TL: Kopya. Dito lang ako sa tabi mo.

translations.EN: I hear you loud and clear. Let's move.
translations.TL: Malinaw kong narinig. Kilos na tayo.

translations.EN: Count on me. We're in this together.
translations.TL: Maaasahan mo ako. Magkasama tayo rito.

translations.EN: Understood. Let's keep our heads clear.
translations.TL: Naiintindihan ko. Panatilihing malinaw ang isip natin.

translations.EN: Right behind you. Let's handle this.
translations.TL: Nasa likod mo lang ako. Asikasuhin natin 'to.

translations.EN: Watch out. We need to move now.
translations.TL: Mag-ingat. Kailangan nating kumilos ngayon din.

translations.EN: Danger close! Move, move!
translations.TL: Malapit ang panganib! Kilos, kilos!

translations.EN: Not safe here. Clear out now.
translations.TL: Hindi ligtas dito. Lumikas na ngayon.

translations.EN: Look around! We need to leave this spot.
translations.TL: Tumingin ka sa paligid! Kailangan nating umalis dito.

translations.EN: Infected coming! Get into cover right now.
translations.TL: Paparating ang mga infected! Magtago na ngayon din.

translations.EN: Trouble's right on us. Relocate immediately.
translations.TL: Nandito na ang gulo. Lumipat agad.

translations.EN: Heads up! We're in the open and exposed.
translations.TL: Ulo niyo! Lantad tayo sa bukas na lugar.

translations.EN: Drop what you're doing, we have to move.
translations.TL: Bitawan ang ginagawa mo, kailangan nating tumakbo.

translations.EN: Danger! Don't freeze up, run!
translations.TL: Panganib! Huwag kang matulala, takbo!

translations.EN: Move now! We're getting cornered.
translations.TL: Kilos na! Naiipit na tayo.

translations.EN: Stay alert.
translations.TL: Manatiling alerto.

translations.EN: Keep your eyes peeled.
translations.TL: Buksan ang mga mata.

translations.EN: Watch our surroundings.
translations.TL: Bantayan ang paligid natin.

translations.EN: Don't let your guard down.
translations.TL: Huwag ibaba ang depensa.

translations.EN: Stay sharp out here.
translations.TL: Maging handa rito sa labas.

translations.EN: Keep quiet and listen.
translations.TL: Tumahimik at makinig.

translations.EN: Keep checking the corners.
translations.TL: Tignan palagi ang mga sulok.

translations.EN: Stay cautious.
translations.TL: Mag-ingat palagi.

translations.EN: Eyes front and back.
translations.TL: Tumingin sa harap at likod.

translations.EN: Stay focused.
translations.TL: Manatiling nakapokus.

translations.EN: Someone died here. We should remember that.
translations.TL: May namatay dito. Dapat nating alalahanin 'yon.

translations.EN: Poor bastard. Didn't make it.
translations.TL: Kawawa naman. Hindi nakaligtas.

translations.EN: Another body in the dirt. World's unforgiving.
translations.TL: Isa na namang bangkay sa lupa. Malupit ang mundo.

translations.EN: They fought hard, by the looks of it.
translations.TL: Lumaban nang husto, base sa hitsura.

translations.EN: Someone lost a life here. Tread with respect.
translations.TL: May nawalan ng buhay rito. Maglakad nang may galang.

translations.EN: Looks like they got trapped. Rest easy.
translations.TL: Mukhang naipit sila rito. Mamahinga ka na.

translations.EN: Could've been any of us. Keep walking.
translations.TL: Kahit sino sa atin pwedeng maging ganyan. Lakad na.

translations.EN: Another survivor cut down too early.
translations.TL: Isa na namang survivor ang pumanaw nang maaga.

translations.EN: Body's cold. Let's make sure we don't end up like this.
translations.TL: Malamig na ang bangkay. Siguruhin nating hindi tayo matutulad dito.

translations.EN: Rest in peace, stranger. Let's keep moving.
translations.TL: Sumalangit nawa ang kaluluwa mo. Magpatuloy tayo.

translations.EN: Someone is going to answer for this.
translations.TL: May mananagot para rito.

translations.EN: They didn't deserve this. Whoever did it will pay.
translations.TL: Hindi nila nararapat 'to. Pagbabayaran 'to ng may gawa.

translations.EN: This wasn't rottens, this was murder. They'll bleed for it.
translations.TL: Hindi 'to gawa ng infected, patayan 'to. Dudugo sila para rito.

translations.EN: I'll find whoever did this and make them regret it.
translations.TL: Hahanapin ko ang may gawa nito at pagsisisihan nila.

translations.EN: They slaughtered them. There's no forgiving this.
translations.TL: Pinaslang nila sila. Walang kapatawaran ito.

translations.EN: Mark my words, retribution is coming for them.
translations.TL: Tandaan mo, darating ang ganti para sa kanila.

translations.EN: Whoever left this body won't walk away clean.
translations.TL: Ang nag-iwan ng bangkay na 'to ay hindi makakatakas nang buo.

translations.EN: Cold-blooded. I won't forget this sight.
translations.TL: Walang awang pagpatay. Hindi ko makakalimutan ang nakita ko.

translations.EN: Blood demands blood. We settle this score.
translations.TL: Dugo ang kabayaran ng dugo. Tutuldukan natin 'to.

translations.EN: They butchered one of our own. They will pay.
translations.TL: Kinatay nila ang isa sa atin. Pagbabayaran nila.

translations.EN: Take care.
translations.TL: Mag-ingat ka.

translations.EN: Stay safe out there.
translations.TL: Maging ligtas ka sa labas.

translations.EN: Watch yourself.
translations.TL: Ingatan mo sarili mo.

translations.EN: Until next time.
translations.TL: Hanggang sa muli.

translations.EN: Keep your guard up.
translations.TL: Panatilihing mataas ang depensa.

translations.EN: Stay sharp on the road.
translations.TL: Magmatyag sa kalsada.

translations.EN: Catch you later.
translations.TL: Mamaya ulit.

translations.EN: Safe travels.
translations.TL: Ligtas na paglalakbay.

translations.EN: Keep breathing out there.
translations.TL: Manatiling buhay sa labas.

translations.EN: See you around.
translations.TL: Magkita na lang tayo.

translations.EN: Take care. I will see you soon.
translations.TL: Mag-ingat ka. Magkikita tayo sa lalong madaling panahon.

translations.EN: Stay safe, my friend. Come back in one piece.
translations.TL: Mag-ingat ka, kaibigan. Bumalik kang buo.

translations.EN: Look after yourself. Don't be a stranger.
translations.TL: Alagaan mo sarili mo. Huwag kang mawawala.

translations.EN: Good luck out there. See you soon.
translations.TL: Magandang kapalaran sa labas. Hanggang sa muli.

translations.EN: Keep your head down and stay safe. Talk soon.
translations.TL: Yumuko sa panganib at mag-ingat. Usap tayo ulit.

translations.EN: It was good seeing you. Safe travels.
translations.TL: Mabuti at nagkita tayo. Ligtas na paglalakbay.

translations.EN: Take care of yourself. I'll be waiting.
translations.TL: Alagaan mo sarili mo. Hihintayin kita.

translations.EN: Watch your back out there, friend.
translations.TL: Bantayan ang likod mo sa labas, kaibigan.

translations.EN: Stay alive. We'll share a drink next time.
translations.TL: Manatiling buhay. Mag-inuman tayo sa susunod.

translations.EN: Be careful out there. See you shortly.
translations.TL: Mag-ingat ka sa labas. Magkikita tayo sa lalong madaling panahon.

translations.EN: We lost someone close to us. We need to stay together.
translations.TL: Nawalan tayo ng taong malapit sa atin. Kailangan nating magsama-sama.

translations.EN: I can't believe they're gone... we have to hold each other up.
translations.TL: Hindi ako makapaniwalang wala na sila... kailangan nating magtulungan.

translations.EN: They were family to us. Don't let our grief break us apart.
translations.TL: Pamilya na ang turing natin sa kanila. Huwag nating hayaang wasakin tayo ng lungkot.

translations.EN: It hurts so much, but we have to keep going for them.
translations.TL: Masakit sobra, pero kailangan nating magpatuloy para sa kanila.

translations.EN: They protected us. Now we protect each other.
translations.TL: Pinrotektahan nila tayo. Ngayon tayo naman ang magpoprotekta sa isa't isa.

translations.EN: Losing them leaves a hole in my heart. Stay close, everyone.
translations.TL: Naiwang sugatan ang puso ko sa pagkawala nila. Magdikit-dikit tayo.

translations.EN: We honor their memory by surviving. Stick together.
translations.TL: Igalang natin ang alaala nila sa pamamagitan ng pamumuhay. Magsama tayo.

translations.EN: I will miss them terribly. We can't scatter now.
translations.TL: Mamimiss ko sila nang husto. Hindi tayo dapat maghiwa-hiwalay ngayon.

translations.EN: They gave everything for this group. We stay united.
translations.TL: Ibinigay nila ang lahat para sa grupong 'to. Manatili tayong nagkakaisa.

translations.EN: Rest in peace. We'll hold the line for you.
translations.TL: Mamahinga ka na. Hahawakan namin ang linya para sa'yo.

translations.EN: Our leader is gone. We keep the group together.
translations.TL: Wala na ang pinuno natin. Panatilihin nating buo ang grupo.

translations.EN: The leader fell, but the colony endures.
translations.TL: Bumagsak ang pinuno, pero mananatili ang kolonya.

translations.EN: We must maintain order. The group cannot collapse.
translations.TL: Kailangan nating panatilihin ang kaayusan. Hindi dapat bumagsak ang grupo.

translations.EN: Our founder is dead, but our camp will survive.
translations.TL: Patay na ang nagtatag sa atin, pero mabubuhay ang kampo natin.

translations.EN: Stay organized. We carry on their work.
translations.TL: Manatiling organisado. Ipagpatuloy natin ang nasimulan nila.

translations.EN: A terrible loss, but our community must stand firm.
translations.TL: Matinding kawalan, pero kailangang tumindig ang komunidad natin.

translations.EN: Don't panic. We keep rations and duties moving.
translations.TL: Huwag mag-panic. Tuloy ang rasyon at mga tungkulin.

translations.EN: The colony needs everyone focused right now.
translations.TL: Kailangan ng kolonya ang pokus ng lahat ngayon din.

translations.EN: We built this together. We keep it standing together.
translations.TL: Sabay natin 'tong binuo. Sabay natin 'tong pananatilihing nakatayo.

translations.EN: Leadership may change, but the settlement survives.
translations.TL: Maaaring magbago ang pamumuno, pero mabubuhay ang paninirahan.

translations.EN: We lost our leader. We need to decide what comes next.
translations.TL: Nawalan tayo ng pinuno. Kailangan nating pagpasyahan ang susunod.

translations.EN: The boss is down. Who's taking charge?
translations.TL: Bagsak ang pinuno. Sino'ng hahawak ng pamumuno?

translations.EN: Without leadership, we need to regroup and plan.
translations.TL: Kung walang namumuno, kailangan nating magtipon at magplano.

translations.EN: Our leader is dead. What do we do now?
translations.TL: Patay na ang pinuno natin. Ano'ng gagawin natin ngayon?

translations.EN: We need to talk about who leads us forward.
translations.TL: Kailangan nating pag-usapan kung sino ang mangunguna sa atin.

translations.EN: The head is cut off. We need a new direction.
translations.TL: Naputol ang ulo ng grupo. Kailangan natin ng bagong direksyon.

translations.EN: Leader's gone. Let's not fall into chaos.
translations.TL: Wala na ang lider. Huwag tayong mahulog sa kaguluhan.

translations.EN: Someone needs to step up and guide the crew.
translations.TL: May kailangang tumindig at gumabay sa grupo.

translations.EN: We're leaderless right now. Keep calm and talk.
translations.TL: Wala tayong pinuno ngayon. Kumalma at mag-usap tayo.

translations.EN: Terrible news. Let's figure out our next steps.
translations.TL: Masamang balita. Pag-isipan natin ang susunod nating hakbang.

translations.EN: We lost someone important. We need to stay together.
translations.TL: Nawalan tayo ng mahalagang tao. Kailangan nating magsama-sama.

translations.EN: They were our guiding light. I don't know what to do without them.
translations.TL: Sila ang tanglaw natin. Hindi ko alam ang gagawin nang wala sila.

translations.EN: I gave my loyalty to them. I feel empty inside.
translations.TL: Ibinigay ko ang katapatan ko sa kanila. Parang walang laman ang puso ko.

translations.EN: They inspired all of us. We must uphold their ideals.
translations.TL: Binigyan nila tayo ng lakas. Dapat nating itaguyod ang simulain nila.

translations.EN: Our beacon is extinguished. God help us.
translations.TL: Namatay na ang tanglaw natin. Diyos ko tulungan mo kami.

translations.EN: I would have followed them to the end. Rest well.
translations.TL: Susundan ko sana sila hanggang dulo. Mamahinga ka na.

translations.EN: They were everything to this cause. We cannot let it die.
translations.TL: Sila ang lahat para sa layuning 'to. Hindi natin hahayaang mamatay 'to.

translations.EN: My faith is shaken, but I will stay with our people.
translations.TL: Nayanig ang pananampalataya ko, pero mananatili ako sa ating mga kasama.

translations.EN: A visionary has fallen. We must honor their sacrifice.
translations.TL: Bumagsak ang ating pinuno. Dapat nating igalang ang sakripisyo nila.

translations.EN: They believed in us. We have to prove them right.
translations.TL: Naniwala sila sa atin. Kailangan nating patunayan na tama sila.

translations.EN: The old order is gone. What happens next is up to us.
translations.TL: Wala na ang dating patakaran. Nasa atin na kung ano ang susunod.

translations.EN: Their reign is over. Time for a better way.
translations.TL: Tapos na ang pamumuno nila. Oras na para sa mas maayos na paraan.

translations.EN: They made terrible choices and paid for it.
translations.TL: Maling desisyon ang ginawa nila at binayaran nila 'yon.

translations.EN: No more taking orders from that fool.
translations.TL: Wala nang susunod sa mga utos ng hangal na 'yon.

translations.EN: The tyrant is dead. Now we decide our own fate.
translations.TL: Patay na ang pinuno. Ngayon tayo na ang magpapasya sa sariling kapalaran.

translations.EN: I won't shed tears for them. Let's build something fair.
translations.TL: Hindi ako iiyak para sa kanila. Magtayo tayo ng makatarungang samahan.

translations.EN: Their leadership was leading us to the grave anyway.
translations.TL: Dadalhin lang din naman tayo ng pamumuno nila sa libingan.

translations.EN: A slate wiped clean. We govern ourselves now.
translations.TL: Burado na ang nakaraan. Pamahalaan natin ang sarili natin.

translations.EN: They're gone. Good riddance to bad orders.
translations.TL: Wala na sila. Mabuti at tapos na ang maling pamamalakad.

translations.EN: We're free to choose our own path now.
translations.TL: Malaya na tayong pumili ng sarili nating landas.

translations.EN: The leader is gone. Someone needs to decide what comes next.
translations.TL: Wala na ang pinuno. May kailangang magpasya sa susunod.

translations.EN: I barely knew them, but we still need structure.
translations.TL: Halos hindi ko sila kilala, pero kailangan pa rin natin ng kaayusan.

translations.EN: Leader died. Life goes on. Who's in charge?
translations.TL: Namatay ang pinuno. Tuloy ang buhay. Sino'ng mamumuno?

translations.EN: A casualty like any other. Let's elect someone new.
translations.TL: Biktima tulad ng iba. Pumili tayo ng bago.

translations.EN: They're gone. We still need food and guards.
translations.TL: Wala na sila. Kailangan pa rin natin ng pagkain at bantay.

translations.EN: Another name scratched off. Let's sort out the command.
translations.TL: Isa na namang pangalan ang nabura. Ayusin natin ang pamumuno.

translations.EN: Doesn't change my daily tasks. Who's giving orders now?
translations.TL: Hindi nababago ang gawain ko. Sino na ang mag-uutos ngayon?

translations.EN: Leader's expired. Pick a replacement and move forward.
translations.TL: Pumanaw na ang lider. Pumili ng kapalit at magpatuloy.

translations.EN: Death is common here. Let's figure out our routine.
translations.TL: Pangkaraniwan ang kamatayan dito. Ayusin natin ang patakaran.

translations.EN: They're dead. What's the practical plan?
translations.TL: Patay na sila. Ano ang praktikal na plano?

translations.EN: I hear you.
translations.TL: Narinig kita.

translations.EN: Understood.
translations.TL: Naiintindihan ko.

translations.EN: Got it.
translations.TL: Nakuha ko.

translations.EN: I'm listening.
translations.TL: Nakikinig ako.

translations.EN: Fair enough.
translations.TL: Makatarungan 'yan.

translations.EN: Sounds good.
translations.TL: Mabuti 'yan.

translations.EN: Copy that.
translations.TL: Kopya.

translations.EN: Noted.
translations.TL: Tandaan ko 'yan.

translations.EN: Makes sense.
translations.TL: May punto ka.

translations.EN: I agree.
translations.TL: Sumasang-ayon ako.
